reason: A DSH Web UI composer utility that indexes workspace paths for @ references and offers searchable current-session prompt history through native input triggers.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 输入框提供工作区文件和目录引用搜索，以及当前会话的历史提示词筛选功能。
summaries.en: Enhances the DSH Web UI composer with searchable workspace file and directory references and current-session prompt history.

capabilities: Indexes workspace file and directory paths for candidate selection
Provides searchable @ file and directory references in the composer
Records and filters successfully submitted prompts from the current session
Adds browser-side composer status and candidate-menu enhancements
